title: Pokémon TCG: Here’s How to Shop the 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box & Booster Bundle Online
summary: Although both are sold out, you can still buy the trading card game sets from retailers across the web.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Since 1996, the Pokémon Trading Card Game has been a staple in pop culture, along with the video game franchise and animated TV series, with fans all around the world. In fact, hoards of collectors and fans have flocked to retailers to snatch up new trading cards and booster packs for the property’s 30th anniversary. Fans are just going crazy for the resurgence of Pokémon TCG.

Although they’ve been sold out at stores, you can still get your hands on the limited-edition Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box and just-released Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Booster Bundle Box at affordable prices from online retailers, like Walmart , Amazon , GameStop and Best Buy .

The Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box has booster packs, foil energy cards and one full art promo card. It also comes with a player’s guide, damage-counter dice, coin-flip die, coins, card sleeves and a special collector’s box to keep everything in its place. It features Pokémon, like Mewtwo ex, Mew ex, Umbreon ex, Salamence ex, Greninja ex and, of course, Pikachu.

Paired with the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration: Elite Trainer Box , but sold separately, the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Booster Bundle comes with six booster packs to add to the game.

While you can buy these sets online with home delivery, some of the retailers, namely Best Buy and GameStop, have the trainer box and booster bundle only available in-stores. However, you can order online anyway, and opt to pick up the sets at the nearest location to your home.

Meanwhile, you can shop the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Elite Trainer Box and Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Booster Bundle Box , as well as other Pokémon TCG sets, at Walmart.

Shop Pokémon TCG at Walmart

And since these Pokémon TCG sets are from Walmart, you’ll get it shipped to you for free if you’re a Walmart+ member . Otherwise, your cart has to be more than $35 to get free shipping.
